sources.beginner: The course's "studio" is Suite Relief & Flare Studio (src/pages/apps/ReliefBlowdownSizer.jsx): required area printed fmt(...,3) (src/components/reliefstudio/PsvResultsPanel.jsx:35), critical ratio and C never printed; prompt asks six decimals. Lessons give constants and tables but no API 520 formulas; NextGen panels are select-only.
sources.intermediate: Tower wetted area and the drum chain by hand from relations the lessons describe (m02/l03:5, m05/l01); the Suite drum route cannot take the stated acf/s and dropout velocity and prints 1-2 decimals; horizontal wetted area only as an integer in the Suite fire chain.
sources.advanced: Inventory, isentropic end temperature and the point-source pair are closed forms from prompt inputs; blowdown time needs the 0.1 s march (Suite BlowdownPanel.jsx:47 prints minutes to 1 decimal) and the choked floor is never printed.

fields.prompt_precision: "The two wetted areas in ft2 to four decimals."
fields.evidence: l01:5,17 teach the exact expression: arc angle from level and radius, arc length from angle and radius, times the 37 ft length; 450.8386 ft2 at full precision.
fields.notes: Suite fire chain prints fmt(psv.wettedFt2, 0) (src/components/reliefstudio/PsvResultsPanel.jsx:72), unusable at the four decimals the prompt asks; the taught geometry is the route.

fields.prompt_precision: "The two wetted areas in ft2 to four decimals."
fields.evidence: "the area is the circumference times the wetted height. No segment, no arc angle, one product" (l03:5): pi x 7.2 x 14.5 = 327.9823, full precision.
fields.notes: Suite fire chain prints it as an integer (PsvResultsPanel.jsx:72), unusable at tol 1e-4; the taught product is the route.

fields.prompt_precision: "The fraction, the velocity in ft a second and both lengths in ft to six decimals."
fields.evidence: Exact circular-segment area fraction at a level of 0.35 D (l01:13 "the exact circular segment"); standard geometry, full precision on a calculator.
fields.notes: The segment formula is described, not written out. The Suite drum route does not print this fraction and cannot take the stated 168 acf/s and 2.05 ft/s dropout velocity (inputs are MMscfd and a droplet size, DrumRadiationPanels.jsx:11,18), so hand geometry is the only route. Borderline on "taught".

fields.prompt_precision: "The fraction, the velocity in ft a second and both lengths in ft to six decimals."
fields.evidence: Actual vapour rate over the vapour segment area: 168 / (A x (1 - fraction)); closed form once the fraction is known.
fields.notes: Suite prints vVaporFtS at 2 decimals (DrumRadiationPanels.jsx:50) and cannot take the stated case.

fields.prompt_precision: "The fraction, the velocity in ft a second and both lengths in ft to six decimals."
fields.evidence: Transit time equals fall time: L = v x (vapour depth) / 2.05 with vapour depth 0.65 D (l01:9,13).

Either print the studio readouts at the course precision (a "full precision" toggle keeps the plant view clean) or widen tol to half a unit of what the studio prints. Recommend the display change: the prompts explicitly promise six decimals. Tolerance alternative: 0.05 (half of 0.1 min is 3 s, far wider than the trap spacing, so the display fix is the only honest one).

fields.evidence: Isentropic end temperature T0 (p/p0)^((k-1)/k) = 555 x (165/1185)^(0.26/1.26) = 369.495959 degR, identical to the graded value to 1e-13; the prompt states isentropic expansion.
fields.notes: Suite prints it in degF with 0 decimals (BlowdownPanel.jsx:50).

fields.evidence: Point source: fraction x transmissivity x Q / (4 pi d^2) as l01:9 describes (sphere, radiated fraction, surviving fraction): 0.27 x 0.91 x 742000 / (4 pi 118^2) = 1.041922.
fields.notes: Suite prints kWm2 at 2 decimals (DrumRadiationPanels.jsx:109) and takes a lb/hr rate and LHV, not kW.

fields.evidence: Same relation inverted: d = sqrt(F tau Q / (4 pi I)) = 52.567818 m.
